description: Source code implementing Redis keyspace event notifications via Pub/Sub, including functions for converting notification class strings to flags, flags to strings, and publishing keyspace events.

methods.name: keyspaceEventsStringToFlags
methods.description: Converts a string of notification class characters into a bitmask of flags.

methods.name: keyspaceEventsFlagsToString
methods.description: Converts a bitmask of notification class flags into a string representation.

methods.name: notifyKeyspaceEvent
methods.description: Publishes keyspace or keyevent notifications based on event type, key, and database ID.
